name: Hassan
style: A patient killer behind a bone mask: four quick cuts that crit from behind every time, a Flash Step that lands him at your back, and a spectral hand that drags you down from anywhere.

moves.name: Bone Flurry
moves.notes: Four quick cuts at arm's length. The fourth is slower and knocks them back. As an Assassin, every cut from behind crits.

moves.name: Rising Cut
moves.notes: A rising cut, a little slower than the flurry, that pops the opponent up to float. Jump after them to keep the combo going.

moves.name: Dropping Knives
moves.notes: Three air cuts. The first two keep the opponent close in the air and float them; the third knocks them down. Hassan drifts along with them while they float.

moves.name: Shadow Drop
moves.notes: Drops straight down with the knives. If it connects, Hassan bounces back up and his air jumps refill.

moves.name: Last Cut
moves.notes: The flurry's last cut made heavier and slower. It cannot be blocked, so a guard does not stop it.

moves.name: Assassin's Throw
moves.notes: Grabs a grounded opponent in reach when the stick points at them, and a guard does not stop it. They can break the hold by pressing LIGHT or HEAVY within 8 ticks (about 0.13 s).

moves.name: Shadow Dirk
moves.notes: A blade thrown from the shadows. Fast, and no guard or parry stops it. Cooldown 288 ticks (about 4.8 s) for an Assassin.

moves.name: Phantom Hand
moves.notes: Rift Art, ready at a full Rift gauge. A spectral claw races along the floor and snatches the opponent even out of a roll or a jump, holding them stunned for about 1.2 seconds while it crushes them. It cannot be blocked, and it heals Hassan by 130 when it lands.

moves.name: Flash Step
moves.notes: A near-instant step of about 150 units along the stick, invulnerable for its first 9 ticks. With no direction held and the opponent close, it lands behind them, facing their back. It can cancel out of any attack except a Rift Art. On the ground it has a cooldown; in the air it uses one of his two air-dash charges.

combos.name: Bread and butter
combos.input: LIGHT, LIGHT, ↓+LIGHT, JUMP, LIGHT, LIGHT, LIGHT (air)
combos.notes: Two cuts, then the rising cut pops them up to float. Jump after them and finish with the air cuts. Hassan's two air jumps give him room to follow.

combos.name: Behind the mask
combos.input: DODGE (no stick, close), LIGHT, LIGHT, LIGHT, LIGHT
combos.notes: A Flash Step with no direction held lands behind them while they are close. Every cut from behind crits at 1.9 times damage, so the flurry hits hard from the back.

combos.name: Drop from above
combos.notes: Two air cuts keep them close, then the shadow drop comes down on them. If it connects, Hassan bounces back up with his air jumps refilled to go again.
